entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 4,625 K, because interstellar dust reddens every spectrum of this star, E(B-V) = 0.08 +/- 0.005 (Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10), and its light changes through each pulsation, through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffe0c1. entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 4,625 K and log g 1.65 (u1 0.729, u2 0.073): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
